note: Optional, hand-edited extra HTML embeds for the Movies & Shows shelf.
The published catalogue is the curated public-domain set plus whatever you
add here. See playlists/vod/EMBEDS.md for the whole picture.
Each entry in "extra" attaches one more embed to one catalogue slug:
provider   the label shown in the player, e.g. "YouTube"
kind       "iframe" (with url) or "html" (with a pasted embed snippet)
url        the iframe src, for kind "iframe"
html       a verbatim embed snippet, for kind "html"
primary    optional; true puts this embed first, ahead of Internet Archive
The build reads this file on every run and validates each entry: a url must
be http(s) and a kind must be iframe or html. Anything unusable is skipped
with a warning and the rest of the catalogue is unaffected.
Leave "extra" empty to publish only the curated Internet Archive embeds.
